verses.1: And he led me through the gate of the Holy Place. It was a door that led to the inside, and it was locked.
verses.2: And the LORD said to me, “This gate shall be closed and never opened again. No one shall enter through it, for the LORD, the God of Israel, has come in through it, and it shall remain closed.”
verses.3: He who is the ruler shall sit there to eat bread before Jehovah. From that door he will come in, and from that path he will go out.
verses.4: And he led me through the gate of the outer court, to the entrance of the house. And I saw that the house of God was filled with the glory of God.
verses.5: And the LORD said to Adam, “Set your mind and eyes on all that I speak to you about all the laws of the house of God, and all its ordinances. And pay attention to carrying out all the commands of God in everything related to the holy things.”
verses.6: And you said to Meri, “To the house of Israel, I say this: ‘Our God, Jehovah, will take away all your sufferings from the house of Israel.’”
verses.7: When you bring along with you the children of other nations, those who are heartless and cruel, so that they may become part of my holy place… Then I will break my covenant with all your troubles.
verses.8: And do not violate the laws that govern my holiness. Instead, keep your own laws in accordance with those that govern my holiness in my holy places.
verses.9: Thus said Adonai Yehovah: “All other children with a wicked heart and evil nature shall not enter my holy place. No one who is among the children of Israel shall be allowed to enter.”
verses.10: For those who have strayed from me, during the times of Israel’s confusion. They have gone astray because of their sins, and they have lost their way.
verses.11: And in my holy places, there were servants who served at the doors of the houses. They also served in the temple. They would slaughter the animals for the people. And they would stand before them to serve them.
verses.12: Because they served them before their destruction, and they became the house of Israel during those times of great suffering. Therefore, I raised my hand over them. May the Lord say, “Let them be saved!”
verses.13: And they will not come to me as priests for me, nor will they be able to touch all my sacred objects. They will be carried away along with their sins and transgressions.
verses.14: And I will give them to be gardeners of the house, to oversee all its work and everything that is done there.
verses.15: And the priests, the sons of Zadok, who kept the sacred offerings safe among the Israelites. They will come to me to serve me, and they will stand before me to offer me milk and blood. May the Lord say so.
verses.16: They shall come to my temple, and they shall bow down before my altar to serve me. They shall also keep my laws.
verses.17: And when they entered the doors of the inner courtyard, they would cover themselves with linen. They would not put cloth over them while they were in the doors of the inner courtyard.
verses.18: The skins of grain will be placed on their heads. And those who bring in the skins of grain will have them placed on their heads. They shall not be tied up with ropes.
verses.19: And when they went out to the outer courtyard, they would take off their clothes that they used for service. They then left them in the sacred areas. They wore other clothes instead, and they did not honor the people with their own clothes.
verses.20: And their heads will not be cut off, and their bodies will not be sent away as slaves. Their heads will be covered with a covering.
verses.21: And no priest shall enter the inner courtyard when they come there.
verses.22: And the bald and the stout men shall not be taken as wives for them, except those who are from the lineage of the House of Israel. And the bald man who is a priest shall be taken as a wife for him.
verses.23: And my people will be separated between the holy and the unholy, between the clean and the unclean. They will know this.
verses.24: And in accordance with their judgments, they will judge them. They will enforce my laws and commandments in all their meetings. They will also uphold my ordinances.
verses.25: And a man shall not be buried in a tomb, except by his father, mother, son, and daughter, as well as by his brother and sisters who were not his own children.
verses.26: And after his purification, he will be told the number seven days.
verses.27: And on the day he goes to the Holy Place, to the inner courtyard where the priest stands before the Holy One, he shall bring his sins before Him. May the Lord say, “Atoni Yehovah.”
verses.28: And it shall be their inheritance. I am their inheritance, and they shall not give it to them in Israel. I am their possessor.
verses.29: The sin, the guilt, and all the punishments will be punished for them in Israel.
verses.30: And from all the produce and all the offerings you bring to the priests, a portion must be given to the priest so that he may bless it before your house.
verses.31: All birds and animals that are born from eggs or from cows shall not be eaten by the priests.
